bill.title: Campaign finance: public disclosure; disclosure of payments for social media posts; require, and require certain information be included in social media posts. Amends secs. 12 & 43 of 1976 PA 388 (MCL 169.212 & 169.243) & adds sec. 59a.

posted_text:
💰 Elections & Voting Rights
MI SB 1199 — Michigan Wants You to Know: Social Media Ads for Campaigns Need Disclosure

Michigan is changing how campaign ads on social media are tracked. Starting April 1st, any committee, agent, or independent contractor paying for a social media post supporting a candidate or ballot question must clearly state who paid for it. This means the post needs a visible disclaimer like 'The author was paid by [name and address]'. ...
